explanation: Cole, a civil servant who had helped Rowland Hill launch the Penny Post, had the artist John Callcott Horsley design it. A Christmas Carol came out the same year.

claims.text: Henry Cole commissioned the first commercial Christmas card in London in 1843.
Charles Dickens, Prince Albert and Rowland Hill did not commission the first commercial Christmas card.
Henry Cole, a civil servant, worked with Rowland Hill on the introduction of the Penny Post.
The artist John Callcott Horsley designed Cole's 1843 Christmas card.
Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol was published in December 1843.
